author: prosenjitghosh
text: Hi Forexlit, This could be the answer you are looking for. This is a reverse Diamond formation, which is a Bullish Pattern, The price wanted to complete the diamond formation, so it went up touched the flag Limit (C) taking out all the pending sell orders there, then came down sharply breaking the demand (1) to attract novice seller's or Breakout seller's and from diamond demand flag Limit (Swap) (2), it went up sharply, changing the trend to up. So what you thought was a Quasimodo is actually a trap laid down by the institutions. And hence your target was not achieved and price hit your stop loss.
